suggestions.quote: It never tells you what that thing is.
suggestions.fix: Replace with “At first, you can't see what that thing is.” This permits the later goal-label reveals instead of contradicting them.

suggestions.quote: you pour tea onto your own shoe; you count change wrong; you nap on a sack of tea leaves.

keep.quote: Every night, the topper's notes. Then yours: zero point zero four per cent.
You can't borrow someone's odds. Only their apron.
But it's his. And it's moving.
